context: A boss and his manager read the morning sports section
purpose: Teach: 中田/渡辺/山口/井上/池田/堀江/橋本/岡田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おっ、今朝のスポーツ欄、見たか？中田選手がまた決勝ゴールを決めたらしいぞ。
lines.en: Oh, did you see the sports section this morning? Apparently Nakata scored another game-winning goal.
lines.style: Booming, jovial morning voice with a satisfied chuckle, mid-50s executive tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、読みました。渡辺監督の采配が見事でしたね。守備の山口さんも素晴らしかったです。
lines.en: Yes, I read it. Coach Watanabe's strategy was brilliant. Defender Yamaguchi was also outstanding.
lines.style: Polite, measured office voice in his thirties, slightly deferential but engaged.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: そういえば野球面では、楽天イーグルスの井上先生が解説してたな。元プロの視点はやっぱり違うよ。
lines.en: Speaking of which, on the baseball page, Mr. Inoue was giving commentary on the Rakuten Eagles. A former pro's perspective really is different.
lines.style: Relaxed, opinionated tone with a hint of admiration, sipping coffee between phrases.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうですね。池田さんのコラムも面白かったですよ。橋本さんとの対談形式で、笑えました。
lines.en: Right. Mr. Ikeda's column was interesting too. It was a dialogue with Mr. Hashimoto, quite amusing.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone, mild laughter in the voice, professional but friendly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: へえ、橋本さんか。久しぶりに名前を聞いたな。あの人、確か堀江社長と仲良かったよな？
lines.en: Oh, Mr. Hashimoto, huh. Haven't heard that name in a while. He was close with President Horie, wasn't he?
lines.style: Curious, slightly reminiscing tone with a raised inflection, classic boss-thinking-aloud cadence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、堀江さんとはゴルフ仲間だったはずです。あ、サッカー欄に岡田監督の引退記事も載ってます。
lines.en: Yes, I believe he and Mr. Horie were golf buddies. Oh, and the soccer page has an article about Coach Okada's retirement.
lines.style: Informative, attentive secretary-like delivery, finding new items on the page as he speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 岡田さんが引退か…時代だなあ。お、ボクシングの記事もあるじゃないか。
lines.en: Okada is retiring... times are changing. Oh, there's a boxing article too, isn't there?
lines.style: Wistful, nostalgic tone shifting to renewed interest, the voice of someone flipping pages.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ああ、それです。世界王者の特集ですよ。さて、そろそろ会議の準備に戻りましょうか。
lines.en: Ah, that one. It's a feature on the world champion. Well, shall we get back to preparing for the meeting?
lines.style: Gentle transition tone, politely steering the conversation back to work, calm and respectful.
